title: She Bought A "Boring Business"... It Almost Ruined Her Life

speakers.name: Andrea Palacio
speakers.role: guest, co-owner of a Miami landscaping company and founder of Andrea Palacio.ai

promo_conflict: Guest promotes her AI program and Instagram lead magnet at the end

stated_problem.quote: And so, in 50 calls a day, trying to do it all at once, the marketing, the admin work, the customer service.
stated_problem.speaker: Andrea Palacio

idea.name: SBA-financed landscaping company acquisition rebuilt with automation
idea.one_liner: Buy a ~$70K/month Florida landscaping company at ~2.3x net income, survive manager and crew exodus, then stabilise with Google Ads, prepaid monthly billing, Make.com post-service photo emails, review routing and an AI phone receptionist
idea.customer: residential and commercial property owners in Miami
idea.offer: recurring lawn maintenance plus landscape enhancement jobs
idea.revenue_model: monthly recurring service billed on the 1st plus one-off enhancement jobs

key_quotes.quote: - Yeah, yeah, we were at $70,000 per month when we acquired the company and we went down to $40,000 per month.
Like one of the things that I would say to anybody is do not ever buy a company, to the seller's not willing to finance the least portion of it, right?
If they were satisfied, you would take them to a Google review, if they weren't, it would automatically take them to a form where they would file a complaint.
I ended up building that agent that called that handled every phone call and booked that appointment directly inside of Java just by like putting pieces together.

claims.quote: And I think it would be like 2.3, the multiple that we paid.
He takes on that rule, and that's when we get an offer for the company for $750,000.

claims.claim: Two automations saved at least 20 hours per month
claims.quote: Huge, with just those two automations, I got at least 20 hours per month back, at least like minimum.

claims.claim: AI-run marketing raised leads ~20% while ad spend fell from $3-4K to $1,500
claims.quote: $4,000 before nots and now we're at 1,500 and they're way more profitable.

claims.claim: Lost 10 of 12 employees after the acquisition
claims.quote: We have gone from 12 employees down to maybe two employees.

acquisition_channels.details: automated Google review requests after each service
acquired a pest control company's book of business

ideas.delivery: crews on trucks; Jobber CRM; Make.com automations; AI voice receptionist (Retell/VAPI-type) books estimates; crew-efficiency KPI dashboard; owner does sales one day per week
ideas.other_uk_rules: Waste carrier licence for green waste; automated review texts to consumers need PECR soft opt-in

idea.name: AI implementation consulting and program for solo business owners
idea.one_liner: Consult on and implement Claude Code/AI automations (receptionists, marketing, admin) for business owners, then productise into a self-paced program with weekly calls, fed by a fast-growing Instagram personal brand and DM-keyword lead magnet
idea.customer: local service businesses, coaches and consultants (solo entrepreneurs)
idea.offer: AI automation consulting, implementation and a group program

key_quotes.quote: I want to start my AI company, where I'm going to help other business owners to exactly the same thing, that I did for this company.
I went from like 7,000 followers all the way to 44,000 and just like a matter of three months.
So I then launched a program for business owners where they could go at their own pace.

claims.claim: Instagram grew from 7K to 44K followers in three months, changing lead generation
claims.quote: And that just changed lead generation for me completely.

acquisition_channels.details: Instagram personal brand; comment/DM keyword auto-sends questionnaire and AI plan

ideas.delivery: Claude Code-built automations; weekly group calls

idea.name: Bolt-on pest control acquisition
idea.one_liner: Acquire a stake in a small pest control company with half seller-financed to add services and revenue to a landscaping business

key_quotes.quote: It was $170,000 that we acquired a company for, and the seller finance half of it.

ideas.other_uk_rules: Professional pesticide use requires certification under UK Plant Protection Products regulations

idea.name: Self-service car wash bought with owner financing
idea.one_liner: Buy a self-service car wash with owner financing, generating ~$5K/month with no money out of pocket

key_quotes.quote: Episode 571 is a cool story with Hannah Ingram, actually buying a self-service car wash with owner financing.
And she said it was like buying a $5,000 a month income stream with no money out of pocket.
